what: Held-out-hospital macro-F1 with the denominator stated. The site has no stage 4/5 or AP-ROP, so a 6-label macro adds two structural zeros — a perfect classifier would score 0.667. macro_f1_present averages only the classes that occur at the site and is the number that describes the model.
reading: Over the four classes the held-out hospital actually has, every arm clears 0.79 (flat 0.792, structured 0.818/0.820 across seeds). The previously quoted 0.528/0.545 measured the class roster of the site, not the classifier. QWK (0.930/0.946), computed only on present classes by construction, never had this problem — which is why the two metrics appeared to disagree.
